resultText:
Insurance status is now on the client card and can be set by schedulers and admins. The full factory run, with typecheck, lint and ac-coverage, passes: all 134 TAP lines are `ok`, including AC-INS-01…06.

- **Database:** the new migration `supabase/migrations/20261118100000_insurance_status.sql` adds `clients.insurance_status` (default `not_set`, with the four-value check). It also adds `public.set_insurance_status(p_client_id, p_status)`:
  - It is `security definer` with `search_path = ''`.
  - It checks the role first, then the status value, then whether the client exists.
  - It returns `OK`, `FORBIDDEN`, `INVALID_STATUS` or `NOT_FOUND`.
  - Execute is granted to `authenticated` only, and there is no UPDATE grant on `clients`.
- **Domain:** `src/lib/clients/insurance.ts` has `INSURANCE_STATUSES`, `insuranceLabel` and `INSURANCE_SAVED`. A `Map` lookup makes unknown values, including inherited keys like `constructor`, fall back to "Insurance: Not set".
- **Card:** `CARD_COLUMNS` and `ClientCardRow` in `src/lib/clients/card.ts` now include `insurance_status`, and I added the column and the function to `database.types.ts` by hand.
- **Page and action:**
  - The card page shows the status in `data-testid="insurance-status"` to everyone who can see the card.
  - Schedulers and admins also get `insurance-form`, with a select (no "Not set" option), a hidden `client_id` and a «Save insurance status» button. Therapists get no form.
  - `setInsuranceStatus` in `src/app/clients/actions.ts` calls the RPC and redirects to `?ok=insurance` on `OK`. Any other code or an RPC error redirects to `?error=<code>`, using `SAVE_FAILED` for RPC errors.
- **Docs:** rows AC-INS-01…06 in `docs/conformance.md` now say «реалізовано» and list their code paths.

**Not verified:**
- The `?error=<code>` redirect is not covered by a visible test.
- The page doesn't show a message for `?error=`, because you said not to invent any other user-facing text. A failed save therefore shows no feedback beyond the missing success message.
- The proxy redirect to `/login` is unchanged, and AC-INS-06 passes in the test suite. The production UAT on the twin is outside this task.
